continuation_retest.reasoning: RTVP p.6 prefers continuation (break, held retest, continue) and rarely trades reversals. No per-session count is printed. Bound by qualifying HTF-edge true breaks with a held retest, not every close beyond the box.

observed_rate_justification.pages: TRAP pp.6-7; RTVP pp.4-8; WIC pp.7-10; fidelity-round8 REPORT section 13.3
observed_rate_justification.text: The generated structure (fidelity-round8 REPORT section 13.3) replaced the drawn balance and the first-close-through break: the balance is the composite value area of the prior five sessions with about eleven generated lines inside it (composite nodes and ledges, the last session's 68% value edges), and the scanner records every break-and-retest cycle of every line as an episode (a break with no retest still records, failing at the confirmation; one retest per cycle, TRAP 'one retest'). The earlier bound [0, 3] was fitted to one drawn balance edge and its first close through. On the 15-date plausibility slice the continuation branch holds 151.7 episodes a session with a pass rate of 0.0246 (about 3.7 all-stage passes a session), the trapped branch 151.7 with 0.0053 (about 0.8). The episode count is the candidate list on generated lines, as for Jumbo's and Green Bird's families; the author's one trade among them is the grading layer's choice (Phase 2). The pass-rate bounds are unchanged and hold.

trapped_buyers_retest.reasoning: TRAP is one worked Asia short with two prior NY failures and a single retest. Dossier S5 says those two sessions are this example, not a universal count. Bound by qualifying trap reads, not every fast arrival.
